opening.argument: The video is centered on medical exam preparation, beginning with a discussion of recalled surgery questions from the AIIMS June 2020 examination. It then develops the underlying clinical material, including the increased risk of endometrial cancer and the ordered sequence of APC, KRAS, DCC, and p53 gene mutations. The promoted surgery app is presented as a source of additional exam-discussion videos, not as an avenue for investment, payment, credential submission, or other financial participation. The observable content therefore supports an educational and operational resource purpose, with the app functioning as an extension of the study material.
